title: Parade time signatures: street music played like dance music
summary: They discuss whether street bands played 2/4 or 4/4 and conclude it was the same as for dancing, with few 6/8 marches.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Would they play 2-4 or 4-4 in a regular march tempo in those days?
Well they mostly played, you see a lot of the dance music, we played that music just like you played then, we played no different.
Oh but in the street, would you play 1-2 or 1-2-3-4?
Well you would play the same thing just like.
Oh I see, the same as the dancing.

Same thing, yeah. Just the same as the dancing. You ever see a fella be skipping and they could dance, you know? Same thing, either 4-4 or split time, which is common time or 2-4 times, you see. Same thing, same on the dance music. We never played no marches. There was no band that played no marches. No 6-8s. No 6-8s. No 6-8s, we didn't play at all.
Well you did play Gettysburg and 6-8s.
